statements.t: We will continue to monitor developments on tariff policy and evaluate any changes to the applicability of tariffs to our business as the occur.
Historically, we have generated and expect to continue to generate positive cash flow from operations.

We believe that our future cash flow from operations and access to capital markets will provide adequate resources to fund our working capital needs, capital expenditures, strategic investments, and share repurchases.

The timing and amount of any shares repurchased will be determined by us based on our evaluation of market conditions and other factors, and will be made in accordance with applicable securities laws in either the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.
In 2026, we expect capital expenditures to be approximately 5% of revenue s.
